scope: Theorem 1.1 (Smooth extension) of the manuscript “Bounded scalar curvature and smooth extension of four-dimensional Ricci flow” (preprints/Bounded-scalar-curvature-and-smooth-extension-of-four-dimensional-Ricci-flow-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 351 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 95655c4053c94f2b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let M be a closed connected smooth four-manifold, let 0 < T < ∞, and let g(t), 0 ≤ t < T, be a smooth Ricci flow with smooth initial metric. If sup M×[0,T) |R(g(t))| < ∞, then there are ε > 0 and a smooth Ricci flow e g(t) on M, 0 ≤ t < T + ε, such that e g(t) = g(t) for every t < T.
